brand_notes: Young direct-sale brand (founder Lucca Chesky, son of David Chesky); 3D-printed cabinets, hand-built to order, 1-year warranty, 4-6 week quoted lead time; LC1 $498 each, LC2 is the larger sibling. Erin measured L/R sample mismatch (eac-chesky-audio-lc1).
takeaways: Erin Klippel: LW ±2.7 dB with 300-700 Hz dip, f3 70 Hz, major DI discontinuity, pref 3.2/5.9.
Measured sensitivity 81.2 dB vs 84 dB claimed (86 dB quoted elsewhere).
Easy load: min 8.4 Ω, EPDR 5.4 Ω.
THD ~1.3% at 86 dB, ~3.5% at 96 dB (graph-read); max SPL ~95 dB.
Critics (FA, ETM) very positive; Erin negative; sample mismatch noted.
conflicts: Bass extension: ETM/FA praise vs Erin f3 70 Hz
Pair-to-pair sample mismatch in Erin's samples
